definition: Wendy Grace Lehnert is an American computer scientist specializing in natural language processing and known for her pioneering use of machine learning in natural language processing.
details: She is a professor emerita at the University of Massachusetts Amherst.
story: Think of a grammar teacher who never memorized a rule but can still tell you when a sentence sounds wrong. The machine learns language the way you did — by hearing so much of it that the patterns sink in. It figures out meaning by noticing which words like to travel together. The machine learns to read between the lines by reading an impossible number of lines. And that is Wendy Lehnert — teaching a machine to read between the lines.
